01 / Why ReMaxMatrix

Two minds.
One standard.

Most teams duplicate themselves. We don't. David and Richard bring deliberately different skill sets to every transaction — institutional pedigree on one side, hands-on construction fluency on the other. The result: fewer blind spots, better questions, sharper decisions.

01

Complementary, not redundant

Where David sees market structure, Richard sees structural integrity. Where Richard models a build, David anticipates the contract. You get two lenses on every property — not two opinions on the same one.

02

Institutional-grade discipline

Trusted by clients through decades of market cycles, regulatory experience, and industry leadership. Process before improvisation. Documentation before promises.

03

Bilingual, locally rooted

Markham-based, fluent across the Chinese-Canadian and broader GTA markets. Negotiation in your language; advocacy in their courts.

03 / Services

What we
do well.

We don't service every transaction type by default — we service the ones our combined background actually improves outcomes on. Below is where the partnership earns its keep.

01 / Residential
⌂

Residential Sales & Acquisition

End-user purchases and listings across the GTA, with the negotiation discipline of a 30-year practitioner and the construction literacy of a licensed builder. Two reads on every offer.

02 / Pre-Construction
◰

Pre-Construction & New Builds

Builder-side fluency turns floor plans, occupancy timelines, and adjustment statements into defensible decisions. We know which clauses matter — and which to push back on.

03 / Commercial
▤

Commercial & Investment

Commercial acquisitions, income properties, and investment opportunities evaluated through both financial and physical due diligence.

04 / Advisory
✦

Strategic Advisory

For clients evaluating a hold/sell/refinance, navigating builder disputes, or structuring multi-property positions. Sometimes the right advice is to wait. We'll tell you when.
